caption:
UWS Briefly · Sep 10–16

• The Trader Joe's at 72nd and Broadway reopened Sept. 12 after 116 days. The escalator still doesn't work.
• A 28-story, 340-unit tower is planned for 200 W. 97th, on the Holy Name church campus. Yes, it has a “glam room.”
• A woman was punched and robbed near Central Park West and 69th on Saturday evening.
• Downtown 1 trains skip 125th, 116th, 110th and more on weekends for the next month.
• Szechuan Gourmet, the Michelin-recommended Midtown place, opened on the UWS on Sept. 12.
• The owners of Friedman's and Pastrami Queen bought an empty UWS restaurant space instead of renting one. Smart.
• Turtles in the Central Park Lake are getting snared on illegal barbed fishing hooks.
• About 250 people rallied at Broadway and 115th for Columbia to reopen its gates. It was the fifth rally.

Links to every story are in our bio.
